flows.title: Create a board
steps: Click the plus icon on the right of your screen underneath Saved.
Enter a name for your board, add collaborators, or turn on the switch next to Keep board secret.
Select Pins for your board and click Done when you are finished.

flows.title: Claim your website with an HTML tag
steps: Click the chevron-down icon at the top-right corner to open your menu.
Click Link to Pinterest from the left-side navigation.
Click the text in the box below Add HTML tag to copy it.
Go to the index.html file of your website and add the tag to the head section before the body section.
Return to Pinterest and enter your website URL in the text box.
